display_title: The Baby Villain Who Foretells the Future

titles_en.title: The Baby Villain Who Foretells the Future
The Oracle of the Villainous Baby

description:
Bunny is a four-year-old orphan who thinks she has finally hit the jackpot when she is taken into a ducal household. But instead of a fairy-tale life, she finds herself in a place where survival is anything but easy. Luckily, Bunny has a mysterious “genius secret notebook” that gives her life-saving advice, helps her win powerful allies, and even reveals shocking future events. With her charm, wit, and uncanny guidance, Bunny slowly captures the hearts of the duke’s family. Yet behind her adorable face lies a far greater secret, one tied to a dark destiny she may not fully understand. As she grows, Bunny must rely on her notebook and her own cleverness to change her fate and become the remarkable person she is meant to be.
